div.div:
Links (point-to-point netdevsim)
■ L1 worker.ens1f0 ↔ worker2.ens3f0 — GM ↔ BC1 slave / OC
■ L2 worker.ens2f0 ↔ worker2.ens3f1 — GM ↔ BC2 slave
■ L3 worker.ens1f1 ↔ worker3.ens5f0 — BC1 master ↔ slave 1
■ L4 worker.ens2f1 ↔ worker3.ens6f0 — BC2 master ↔ slave 2
■ L5 worker2.ens4f0 ↔ worker3.ens7f0 — GM ↔ follower port 0
■ L6 worker2.ens4f1 ↔ worker3.ens7f1 — GM ↔ follower port 1

text.tspan: ■ L1 worker.ens1f0 ↔ worker2.ens3f0 — GM ↔ BC1 slave /
■ L2 worker.ens2f0 ↔ worker2.ens3f1 — GM ↔ BC2 slave
■ L3 worker.ens1f1 ↔ worker3.ens5f0 — BC1 master ↔ slave
■ L4 worker.ens2f1 ↔ worker3.ens6f0 — BC2 master ↔ slave
■ L5 worker2.ens4f0 ↔ worker3.ens7f0 — GM ↔ follower port
■ L6 worker2.ens4f1 ↔ worker3.ens7f1 — GM ↔ follower port

div.div:
Scenario roles
OC: GM = worker2, slave = worker (any link, e.g. L1)
BC: GM = worker2 → BC = worker nic1 → slave1 = worker3 (L1, L3)
DualNICBC / HA: GM = worker2 nic1 (ens3f0 + ens3f1), BC1 = worker nic1, BC2 = worker nic2, slave1/2 = worker3 (L1–L4)
DualFollower: GM = worker2 nic2 (ens4f0 + ens4f1), follower = worker3 nic3 (ens7f0 + ens7f1) (L5, L6)
Each link is a 2-port LAN (no switch). Ports on the same NIC share one PHC. A GM feeding two remote ports uses two ports on the same NIC.
